metadata.title: What is Revenue Leak?
metadata.description: Revenue Leak is the gap between the revenue your traffic should produce and what actually comes in. Five layers, measured and translated into euros.

hero.title: Revenue Leak: the revenue you've already earned, but don't receive.
hero.lede: You're already paying for demand, through ads, organic reach, or word of mouth. But between the click and the payment, part of that demand stalls on the technical foundation. That gap is what we call Revenue Leak.

RevenueLeakPage.quote: “Revenue Leak is the gap between the revenue your traffic should produce and what actually comes in.”

layers.title: Five layers between demand and revenue

signals.title: CEO signals
signals.intro: Each one a symptom of the same problem: patterns we see in brands before they commission an audit.

method.title: From signal to euros
method.p1: Every technical finding is tied to a measurable signal (load time, error rate, checkout drop-off, missing tracking data) and translated into estimated revenue loss per month and per year. Where possible we use your own traffic and conversion data to underpin that translation; where we can't, we use industry benchmarks and make that explicit.
method.p2: So you don't get a loose list of technical remarks, but a business case: what it costs to do nothing, and what it returns to fix it.

cta.heading: Know within weeks where your leak sits.
cta.body: The Revenue Leak Audit measures all five layers and translates them into amounts.
